title: A New Jersey town agreed to spend $13.4 million to preserve 50 acres once eyed for dense housing
summary_full: In an impactful move, Denville Township has acquired seventeen acres dedicated to an essential land preservation effort, shielding around fifty acres from encroaching residential developments. This initiative also includes a plan to add thirty-three more acres by October 2026, ultimately creating a welcoming public park and safeguarded natural area to maintain Denville's unique heritage and ecology for future generations to enjoy.
